disposition.reason: This docket is an enforcement action by the Secretary of the Agency of Natural Resources to enforce a state administrative order about a failed leach field and a dog kennel business, not an appeal of a municipal land-use decision, and it concerns no new housing.

evidence.quote: the Secretary of the Vermont Agency of Natural Resources (the Secretary) filed an amended complaint under 10 V.S.A. ' 8014(a) to enforce a final administrative order
Defendant agreed to replace the failed leach field on her property
Decision and Order on Contempt Petition

judgments.note: State ANR enforcement of an administrative order (10 V.S.A. 8014) with a contempt ruling; no municipal decision is appealed and the subject is a leach field and dog kennel, not new housing.
Enforcement brought by a state agency, not an appeal of a municipal decision.
Subject is wastewater compliance (leach field replacement) and a kennel business at an existing property; no new housing proposed.
